manifest.name: Weather Alerts
manifest.description: Checks US National Weather Service alerts for one place on its own and posts each new warning (and, if chosen, watches) into Juli’s chat; shows the forecast. US only. Fits: storm, heat, flood, winter weather alerts for a town.
manifest.author: p0pc0rn

post_level.desc: what to post: warnings only, warnings and watches, or every alert

place_hint.desc: a town the person named, to pre-fill the search (they still confirm it)

notes_for_juli: Keep the title short. post_level: warnings when the person wants only serious alerts, all when they want everything, otherwise watches. place_hint = the town if the person named one, else leave it out. Never invent a location.
